data.name: Emerencia
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'emergere' meaning 'to arise', this name signifies help or rescue. In Christian tradition, Emerencia is a female name associated with Saint Emerentiana, a martyr who was discovered and rescued from a well by a hunter named Maurus.

data.numerology_meaning: Nurturing and caring, you are a healer.

data.cultural_impact: The name Emerencia carries a sense of resilience, strength, and rebirth, reflecting the story of Saint Emerentiana who was rescued from obscurity and brought to the light. In various cultures, it might signify hope, new beginnings, or triumph over adversity.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Emerencia embodies the belief in redemption, salvation, and divine intervention. It symbolizes the idea that even in the darkest of situations, one can be found and brought out of the depths through faith and trust in God. This name serves as a reminder that even when we feel lost or forgotten, His love can reach us and grant us the strength to rise and face our challenges, just like Saint Emerentiana.
